How this was counted

Delivered means a ticket reached one of the statuses Done or Closed. That list is a setting in Argus rather than the workflow in Jira.

Work counted here if it finished between 5 Jan 2026 and 18 Jan 2026: from the sprint opening to the moment it was completed in Jira, not to the date it was meant to end.

Epic and Story are containers: their points are a rollup of the work beneath them and are never counted as delivery.

A day off cost a whole point of capacity, whatever the baseline: a point is a day, so a day away is a point not delivered.

A logged entry credits the one account its comment mentions, when the author is somebody else; otherwise it credits the author. This is for a team where one person logs the time of the whole team at close.

One point is taken as 6.0 hours, which is how logged time becomes points on carryover.

The sprint is 10 working days long, which is what turns a day off into a share of a baseline.

Points are read from the Story Points field.
